hook: This dog was alone on a roof in a flood.
narration: This dog was alone on a roof, in the middle of a flood.
Hurricane Florence had put the whole area underwater.
A National Guard crew spotted it, with no one anywhere near.
So they lowered a swiftwater rescue swimmer on the cable.
No owner. He put the dog in a special harness and rode the hoist back up with it.
outcome: And the dog made it out of the flood.
title: Dog stranded alone on a flooded roof
description:
After Hurricane Florence in September 2018, a Connecticut National Guard helicopter crew supporting North Carolina spotted a dog stranded alone on a roof. A swiftwater rescue swimmer put the dog in a harness and rode the hoist up with it.

Footage: U.S. Army video, Connecticut National Guard, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/652963

question_comment: Would you go back for your dog in a flood?

facts.claim: Guard rescues dog stranded on roof after Florence
facts.source_quote: Soldiers with the Connecticut National Guard rescue a dog stranded on a roof during a Search and Rescue mission in the aftermath of Hurricane Florence
Then we saw a dog on a rooftop and it didn't look like anybody was in the area
We actually lowered the Swift Water Rescue swimmer down to check it out

facts.claim: No owner, harness, rode the hoist
facts.source_quote: He didn't see any owner, so he picked up the dog

facts.claim: Dry land, might not have made it
facts.source_quote: I don't know if that dog would have made it otherwise
